tickets.title: EEG subset alignment, QC and classical decoding
tickets.notes: 19 subjects, docs/ds002158-eeg.md. Stage 1 (sub-02, sub-04) exploratory; stage 2 pre-registered (configs/ds002158_eeg_decoding_confirmatory.yaml) on 17 new subjects: 109/111 runs paired by timing; gradient + BCG template subtraction in all; positive control 17/17. Confidence after own decisions, post-decision window: within r = 0.16 (Holm p = 0.0009), leave-one-subject-out r = 0.10 (Holm p = 0.005); not pre-decision; mostly shared with accuracy/RT/evidence (residual r = 0.08 within, ~0 across). Follow-ups (post hoc): within-subject effect robust to OBS BCG removal (r = 0.12, Holm 0.028); cross-subject transfer is not (r = 0.04, Holm 0.36); ECG-only control does not carry the post-decision signal. Exploratory time course: ~0.2-0.6 s after the response, nothing before.
